name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 26 - Am 48
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 26a. Regrets, therefore, the cuts, over the course of successive Multiannual Financial Frameworks, in the allocations earmarked for social, economic and territorial cohesion; Urges that these allocations be increased in the 2026 budget;
